sections.title: PFRDA Grade A 2026 — Day 3 — Final Replacement MCQ Bank

explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:01:r1: NPS Trust holds pension assets in trust for subscribers and protects their interests. The other intermediaries perform recordkeeping, banking, investment-management or custody functions.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:02:r1: Section 36 provides an ordinary 45-day period, with statutory scope to condone delay on sufficient cause.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:03:r1: The stated FY 2030–31 objective is 50% of GDP with a ±1 percentage-point range.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:04:r1: The Survey reported scheduled commercial bank gross non-performing assets at about 2.2% in September 2025.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:05:r1: Returning goods reduces the liability to the supplier, so Trade Payables is debited. Under the periodic system, Purchase Returns is credited.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:06:r1: Purchase and disposal of long-term assets such as property, plant and equipment are ordinarily investing activities.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:07:r1: The company has received cash but still owes the service; that obligation is a liability commonly called unearned revenue or a contract liability.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:08:r1: Vroom links motivation to expectancy (effort→performance), instrumentality (performance→outcome) and valence (value of outcome).
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:09:r1: A superior can delegate authority and responsibility for work, but cannot fully abdicate ultimate accountability.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:10:r1: Bond price and required yield move inversely because the fixed future cash flows are discounted at a higher rate when yield rises.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:11:r1: The importer will need dollars later, so buying (going long) US dollars forward locks in the future exchange rate.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:12:r1: The secondary market facilitates trading of securities that have already been issued.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:15:r1: Just-in-time systems minimise inventory buffers, so supplier or logistics disruption can halt production rapidly.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:16:r1: Section 123 permits dividend from eligible profits subject to statutory conditions, including the depreciation requirement.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:17:r1: Section 144 lists internal audit among services that the statutory auditor must not provide to the audited company, subject to the statutory framework.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:18:r1: An independent director can generally serve up to two consecutive terms, each up to five years, followed by the statutory cooling-off period.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:19:r1: The ordinary quorum is one-third of total strength or two directors, whichever is higher, subject to the Act's qualifications.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:21:r1: Personal remittances are current-account secondary income/transfers, not capital or portfolio investment flows.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:22:r1: A repo-rate cut generally eases monetary conditions and can reduce borrowing costs, though transmission is not mechanically one-for-one.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:23:r1: Ordinary Tier II is a voluntary savings account with flexible access, distinct from Tier I retirement-exit restrictions.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:24:r1: From 1 October 2022, a person who is or has been an income-tax payer cannot open a new Atal Pension Yojana account under the notified eligibility rule; earlier qualifying accounts are not automatically cancelled.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:25:r1: The defining difference is when periodic annuity payments commence.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:26:r1: Recall asks: of all actual positives, how many were found? Hence TP/(TP+FN), where TP = True Positive and FN = False Negative.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:27:r1: A post-outcome variable contains information unavailable at real prediction time and leaks the target/future into model development.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:28:r1: Agenda-setting is about issue salience—what people think about—not deterministic control of what they think.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:29:r1: The services-marketing additions are People, Process and Physical Evidence.
explanations.pfrda:day3-bank-b:q:30:r1: Noise is any interference that distorts or disrupts the signal/message between sender and receiver.
